## What you will learn

- Read, write, and explain Python programs.
- Work with values, collections, functions, objects, and files.
- Find bugs and check that your programs behave as intended.
- Build, test, document, and share practical Python projects.

## Before you start

You only need a browser to begin; no programming or mathematics prerequisite
is assumed.

**Practice setup:** start in Colab, then learn local workflows for larger projects.
Lessons combine explanations, runnable examples, checkpoints, and a lab.
Each unit ends with a challenge that brings its ideas together.

## Learning sequence

Python Foundations curriculum version 21 contains **16 units** and
**97 cohesive lessons**. Each unit begins with an Overview and
ends with a challenge.

## Assessment and progress

Predict, run, explain, modify, quiz, and debug as you work through each lesson.
Then apply what you learned in the unit challenge. Most challenges take
60–120 minutes and include progressive checks, hints, and a solution to review
when you need it.

Progress is saved privately in this browser and is self-reported. It is not
a grade or a verified credential. The final project and certificate are planned;
participation details will be announced when they are available.
